fullDesc: The Taj Mahal in Agra was completed around 1653. Shah Jahan built it as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal, who died in 1631, and about 20,000 workers took part.
realFacts: It took over 20 years to build
Shah Jahan was later imprisoned by his son
The marble came from Makrana in Rajasthan
It draws millions of visitors yearly
